title: cyclobalanus bennettii
intro: Cyclobalanus bennettii, commonly known as the Taiwan cinnamon or Sansho, is a species of cinnamon tree native to Taiwan. The plant is valued for its aromatic bark, which is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cyclobalanus bennettii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which may help alleviate digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Cyclobalanus bennettii include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain and discomfort, and boost the immune system, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include cinnamaldehyde, cinnamyl acetate, and linalool.
